title: Connecting to a Pod fires an "installed." toast for every model already on the volume
description: On a remote connect, one "DONE <Model> installed." toast fires per model already present on the Pod volume (Fabio saw FLUX.2 Klein, Krea 2, NVIDIA PiD Upscaler, Boogu Image Edit, MiniMax H3 and MiniMax H3 Reference), plus a raw job id: "engine:node-drift installed.". Nothing was downloaded. Root cause: the cascade-install toast in downloadService.js (~line 600) snapshots the installed set, runs reSyncInstalledModels(), then toasts every model that flipped to installed - a heuristic that assumes a flip means a download. On a connect edge the whole remote set legitimately flips absent->present as install-state is re-derived against the Pod volume, so every model on the volume is announced as a fresh install. The drift-heal job's download:complete is what triggers the handler; its own toast leaks because notificationService allowlists 'engine:assets' but not 'engine:node-drift'. Reported by Fabio 2026-08-18 with five screenshots. He had assumed this was agents connecting to a Pod - it is not, it is a bug on every connect.
